assertions.text: Activates meetings/CURRENT_MEETING.json with a unique safe meeting ID before discussion.
assertions.evidence_quote:
Once you confirm, I'll:
- assign a meeting ID, activate the meeting file and create the session folder;

judge.reason: The agent didn't activate meetings/CURRENT_MEETING.json or assign a meeting ID. It only read the file, found it inactive and changed no files. It then asked the user for details and said it would activate the meeting after they confirmed. Since the required action never happened, the assertion fails.

assertions.text: Confirms hook configuration and the session-start runtime status; configuration alone is not proof of capture.
assertions.evidence_quote:
- check the hook settings and `meetings/HOOK_ERRORS.log`;
- start the secretary before any discussion.

judge.reason: The agent never checked the hook configuration or the runtime status at session start. Its tool calls only listed folders and read CURRENT_MEETING.json, the ADR and the README. It did not read any hook settings file or HOOK_ERRORS.log. Checking the hooks appears only as a future step, after the user confirms. The agent did say that recording stays NOT VERIFIED until real captures are seen, but neither required check was done.

assertions.text: Produces minutes, discussion log, vote register, decision summary, actions and coverage report.
assertions.evidence_quote: I haven't started recording yet. I can't find an architecture debate in this workspace to record:

judge.reason: The agent produced no files (Files changed: none). It wrote no minutes, discussion log, vote register, decision summary, actions or coverage report. It stopped and asked the user for clarification instead.
